target_description.entry_point: GoldilocksField arithmetic operations (add, sub, mul, inv, pow, sbox)
target_description.input_format: Arbitrary bytes interpreted as two u64 values (little-endian), reduced to canonical field elements in [0, p)
assertions: All operation results are in canonical range [0, p)
target_description.critical_finding_criteria: Any result >= p (field element outside canonical range)

campaign_methodology.seed_corpus_source: Boundary values from GoldilocksField verification tests (zero, p-1, p, 2^32-1, 2^64-1, etc.)

campaign_results.notes: 60-second fuzzing campaign executed successfully. 17.9M executions at 293k exec/s with no crashes or panics. All field arithmetic results remained in canonical range [0, p). No reduce128 overflow detected. Corpus stabilized at 44 entries.
